title: FOMC communications blackout begins (through 2027-09-16) — it opens four days after the August 2027 FHFA HPI and Consumer Confidence prints
source: EST: DERIVED THIS SESSION FROM TWO FEDERAL RESERVE PRIMARIES, both fetched direct 2026-09-06 rather than inherited from a sibling ledger. (1) federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/files/fomc-blackout-period-calendar.pdf (HTTP 200, 98,013 bytes), whose content streams were inflated in-session and which states the policy VERBATIM: "The blackout period will begin at 12:00 a.m. Eastern Time the second Saturday before a meeting and end at 11:59 p.m. Eastern Time the day after a meeting. For example, if the Committee meeting starts on a Tuesday, the blackout period will begin at the start of the Saturday that falls ten days earlier, and if the meeting ends on a Wednesday, the blackout period will end at the end of Thursday." (2) federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomccalendars.htm (HTTP 200, 164,831 bytes, footer "Last Update: August 19, 2026"), parsed row-by-row into 56 meeting date-pairs, whose 2027 panel reads "September | 14-15*". 2027-09-14 is a Tuesday, so the Saturday ten days earlier is 2027-09-04; the meeting ends Wednesday 2027-09-15, so the window closes at the end of Thursday 2027-09-16. The same arithmetic reproduces every 2027 blackout entry this calendar already carries (01-16, 03-06, 04-17, 05-29, 07-17) to the day. CORROBORATED INDEPENDENTLY TWICE: this repo's own decode of the Board's shaded PDF, recorded verbatim in the fomc-blackout-start-2027-07-17 entry's source field, lists the 2027 windows as "Jan 16-28, Mar 6-18, Apr 17-29, May 29 -> Jun 10, Jul 17-29, SEP 4-16, Oct 16-28, Nov 27 -> Dec 9"; and the consumer-confidence-2027-08-31 ledger, written the same day by a different lane, independently states the 2027-07-29 -> 2027-09-04 clear-air gap as 37 days. Filed estimate, not confirmed, for two reasons and neither is a weak source: this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep, and it is a firm rule applied to a TENTATIVE meeting date -- fomccalendars.htm states every 2027 date is "tentative until confirmed at the meeting immediately preceding it", so the promotion trigger is the 2027-06-08/09 meeting ratifying September 14-15, not a better fetch. Discovered during the fhfa-hpi-2027-08-31 initial research, checked 2026-09-06
notes: DISCOVERED during the fhfa-hpi-2027-08-31 initial-research adjacency sweep (2026-09-06). It is the only dated event this sweep found inside the five-day corridor that the calendar did not already carry, and it earns a slot for a structural reason rather than for proximity alone. THE AUGUST FHFA PRINT IS NORMALLY THE FURTHEST FROM THE FED AN FHFA RELEASE CAN STRUCTURALLY GET: all six August releases since 2021 sit at EXACTLY 21 days from the nearest FOMC day, 0 of 6 in a blackout, on the identity lastTue(Aug) + 21 == thirdTue(Sep) -- a twin of the February result the fhfa-hpi-2027-02-23 ledger built its stance on. 2027 IS THE ONE POSTED YEAR THAT BREAKS IT. The Board put September 2027 on the SECOND Tuesday (14-15), the only non-third-Tuesday September in seven postings, which pulls the blackout forward from a structural 2027-09-11 to 2027-09-04 and drops the FHFA print's distance from 21 days to 14. So 2027-08-31 -- which carries BOTH the quarterly FHFA HPI at 9:00 ET and the Conference Board's Consumer Confidence at 10:00 -- clears the blackout by FOUR DAYS, the narrowest clearance any August release has had, and the two prints are the last macro releases of the pre-blackout window rather than sitting in the middle of a 37-day one. That is a fact about a corridor two existing ledgers reason about, which is why it is proposed as an event and not merely noted. Proposed as an estimate on a tentative meeting date; estimates only widen caution and nothing here licenses an entry.
